name: Strapi
description: Strapi is an open-source, TypeScript-based headless CMS that lets developers build and manage content APIs without vendor lock-in, while giving editors a familiar admin panel.
best_for: Developers who need a customizable, framework-agnostic headless CMS with full data ownership for websites, mobile apps, and e-commerce.

tiers.name: Community (self-hosted)
tiers.notes: MIT-licensed open source, permanently free. No Live Preview, Releases, Content History, or SSO.

tiers.name: Strapi Cloud Starter
tiers.notes: $35/mo if billed monthly; $29/mo effective rate requires annual billing. 100k API requests/month, 50GB storage, 1 environment, 7-day observability logs.

tiers.name: Strapi Cloud Pro
tiers.notes: $90/mo billed monthly, about $75/mo billed annually. 1M API requests/month, weekly backups. Extra environment costs +$60/mo.

tiers.name: Strapi Cloud Business
tiers.notes: $450/mo billed monthly, about $375/mo billed annually. 10M API requests/month, daily backups, 99.9% uptime SLA. Extra environment costs +$300/mo.

tiers.name: Self-hosted Growth
tiers.notes: Self-hosted paid license adding Live Preview, unlimited Releases, and 14-day Content History. SSO is a paid add-on here, at +$150/month plus $50/seat.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales. Adds unlimited review workflows, audit logs, and SSO included by default.

cons: Strapi Cloud's free hosting tier was discontinued as of July 1, 2026 — existing free-plan Cloud users had to upgrade to a paid plan or delete their projects; self-hosting the open-source Community edition remains free, but the free-to-deploy-on-Cloud on-ramp is gone.

SSO isn't included until deep into paid tiers — on the $45/month self-hosted Growth plan, SSO is a separate paid add-on costing an extra $150/month plus $50/seat, and is only bundled by default on the custom-quote Enterprise plan.
Additional environments beyond the one bundled cost significantly extra on Strapi Cloud: +$60/month per extra environment on Pro and +$300/month per extra environment on Business.
features: Content-Type Builder for creating content models without code
Automatic REST and GraphQL API generation from content models
Components and dynamic zones for reusable, editor-arrangeable content blocks
Framework-level customization of controllers, services, and middleware
Self-hosting on any infrastructure or managed Strapi Cloud with Postgres, CDN, and email
Audit logs, review workflows, content history, and SSO for enterprise plans

alternatives.name: Contentful
alternatives.description: A headless CMS providing structured content management and delivery through APIs for web and mobile apps.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing an enterprise-ready headless CMS with strong API tooling

alternatives.name: Sanity
alternatives.description: A headless CMS built around structured content and a real-time collaborative editing environment.
alternatives.best_for: Developer teams wanting real-time collaboration and customizable editing tools

alternatives.name: Directus
alternatives.description: A self-hostable headless CMS and backend that wraps any SQL database with instant REST and GraphQL APIs.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want to turn an existing database into a governed API and admin panel
